name: Allbridge CCTP phantom deposit
summary: CCTPTokenMessenger.receiveCctpMessage read amount, source sender and hook hash at fixed offsets of any Circle message it relayed, never checking that Circle's TokenMessenger sent it. A self-sent generic CCTP message with a crafted body recorded a phantom deposit that Router.receiveToken paid out in USDC.
notes: The exploit's forged body copied remoteTokenMessengers(5), the Polygon sender set in the reset tx (domain 7 mapping and Router registration landed earlier in the same block); the check passes only with that value.

Campaign: every MessageReceived on the Allbridge CCTP messengers on Base, Ethereum, Polygon (0xdac2959b, old 0xf9b710e4) and Arbitrum (0x1ab89cb3, old 0xf9b710e4) whose relayed message was not sent to Circle's TokenMessengerV2, plus each forger's Router claim tx. Copycats 0xf33f35 (Base) and 0x3c4435 (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum) drained small Router balances.
The anchor's Router outflow is net of the 808,844 USDC the attacker flash-borrowed into the Router within the same tx; the flash-loan premium is not a victim loss.
